subject: SIG: tenant audit-log sampling, retention policy & customer access — onboarding plan
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@kitepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@kitepay.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request: sample logs + retention details for tenant environment

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — KitePay is working through a SIG questionnaire and we're collecting evidence around audit logs and monitoring for our security review. A few specific asks:

- Can you confirm Redwood's default tenant-level event retention and whether configurable retention windows are available (we currently expect 90 days but need confirmation and any tiering options).
- For onboarding we need a sample export of tenant events (one week's worth, preferably in gzip'd JSON or CSV), redacted for PII.
- Does Redwood support providing customer access to their own logs (e.g., presigned S3 URLs or short-lived console views)? If yes, what are the TTLs and audit controls for that access?
- Are there built-in sampling or aggregation modes (e.g., full events vs. summary) we should be aware of for cost-sensitive environments?

Timeline: our security team would like samples and a short evidence memo within 5 business days. Let me know if that is feasible and what you need from us (tenant IDs, timeframe, PO).

Appreciate it —
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Security Analyst, KitePay
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@kitepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request: sample logs + retention details for tenant environment

Thanks Alicia — looping in Karthik from infra/serving runtime so we can get the exact export and retention mechanics.

Quick clarifying Qs before we assemble artifacts:
- For the sample export, do you want raw event payloads (full KV cache, model call metadata) or a minimized schema (timestamp, event_type, user_id, request_id, outcome)? We can provide both but full payloads will need stronger redaction.
- Will you accept a time-bound presigned S3 delivery, or do you prefer a Drive link behind our data room? Our standard is presigned S3 + short-lived access for exports.

Proposed timeline from our side: 48 hours to produce a redacted 7-day sample + evidence memo, and a follow-up runbook for customer-driven exports (syslog/S3/webhook options). If you need full backlog exports beyond that, we'll confirm SLA/PO and estimate delivery (typically 7-10 business days depending on retention slice).

Karthik — can you confirm the default retention tiers and whether we can carve a 1-year retention for KitePay if requested?

Regards,
Soojin
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@kitepay.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG request: sample logs + retention details for tenant environment

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 11:00 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Karthik — can you confirm the default retention tiers and whether we can carve a 1-year retention for KitePay if requested?

Quick summary from infra:
- Default tenant event retention: 90 days (hot tier).
- Cold tier available for 1 year (by request / reserved capacity config). Cold tier moves compressed, parity-protected slices to lower-cost object store; retrievals are subject to a read-latency SLA (typically ~2 hours for bulk retrieval).
- We support per-tenant retention overrides on Dedicated & Private deployments; Hosted tenants can request a retention-exception (adds to ordering flow; requires PO for longer retention beyond default).

Export & sampling details:
- Exports can be produced as gzipped NDJSON or compressed CSV.
- We offer three sampling modes: full events (complete payloads), schema-reduced (only minimal fields), and aggregated summaries (rollups by minute/hour).
- PII handling: event payloads containing sensitive fields are masked by default in hosted exports unless customer signs an evidence release. We can provide redacted samples within 48 hours.

Customer access options:
- Presigned S3 URLs: yes. Generated per-export, TTLs configurable (default 1 hour, can extend up to 72 hours for scheduled deliveries). All presigned access events are logged and appear in our own audit trail (with presigned token id).
- SIEM forwarding: syslog over TLS and webhook (JSON) are supported for streaming use-cases. Both include header-level signing for authenticity.
- Console view: per-tenant read-only console that shows event counts, top event types, and provides an export button that issues a presigned URL. Console actions are audited.

Attachments we can provide now (stubs): sample-audit-log-20260801.json.gz (redacted), redwood-export-playbook.pdf (procedural playbook). I'll attach a redacted CSV for quick review.

If KitePay needs chain-of-custody / hash proofs for exported slices, we can include manifest files with SHA256 checksums.

-Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@kitepay.com>

On Wed, Aug 5, 2026 at 12:25 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attachments we can provide now (stubs): sample-audit-log-20260801.json.gz (redacted), redwood-export-playbook.pdf (procedural playbook).

Thanks, that is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our security team:
- Please include an example manifest with checksums as you mentioned (SHA256 preferred).
- For the presigned S3 flow: can you confirm the auth/assurance around token issuance? We need to show that tokens are created by Redwood and include tenant id / export id bindings.
- For SIEM forwarding: does Redwood support mapping event fields to common log models (CEF or Elastic ECS)? If not out-of-the-box, how long to provide a mapping doc?

We're ok with the 48-hour redacted sample. Can you also include the HubSpot deal id in the evidence package so our procurement team can trace approvals?

Thanks —
Alicia
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Alicia — thanks, we can deliver everything requested. Final plan & next steps: 

1) Artifacts we will deliver within 48 hours:
   - redacted-sample-logs-20260801.csv (PII masked)
   - sample-audit-log-20260801.json.gz (redacted NDJSON)
   - export-manifest-20260801.txt (SHA256 checksums for each chunk)
   - short evidence memo (PDF) referencing HubSpot deal id 67890

2) Technical clarifications:
   - Presigned S3 tokens are issued by our control plane and include the tenant_id and export_id in the associated manifest; token issuance events are included in the Redwood audit trail and will be visible if KitePay requests an export of control-plane events.
   - SIEM forwarding: we provide an ECS mapping doc within the playbook; if KitePay requires CEF we can produce a one-off mapping (estimate 3 business days).
   - TTLs: default presigned URL = 1 hour; can be configured per-export up to 72 hours for scheduled deliveries.

3) Delivery method & access control:
   - We'll upload artifacts to a restricted Drive folder (link below) and also provide a presigned S3 URL for download. Drive link will be permission-gated to Alicia and Rajiv.

4) Timeline for full/backfill exports:
   - If KitePay requests >90-day exports, we'll need a written request/PO for retention override; once approved, ETA is 7-10 business days for the export.

5) Next steps:
   - I'll schedule a 30-minute technical review for next Tue (Aug 11) to walk through the sample and runbook. Please confirm availability.

Attachments: redacted-sample-logs-20260801.csv; sample-audit-log-20260801.json.gz; redwood-export-playbook.pdf; export-manifest-20260801.txt
